description: This file is a shell script used for testing UTF-8 normalization conversions between decomposed (NFD) and precomposed (NFC) Unicode forms. It sets up various test cases to validate Git's handling of Unicode filenames and content normalization, particularly focusing on consistency across diff, log, checkout, and other Git commands in relation to Unicode normalization forms.

methods.name: ls_files_nfc_nfd
methods.description: Configures Git to test Unicode precompose and decompose handling by initializing repositories, setting configurations, and comparing file status output in different Unicode normalization states.
